items.note: S1.7 and S1.8 restate Lemma lem:scalar-motifs correctly: y_S becomes y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch, and three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary value restored. The construction itself (h=100, triples, copy/gather/scatter/side injection, the eight-row schedule, the net map (JV+RG)x, wire counts) is absent, so this is stated, not derived.

S1.1 gives the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, matching lines 818-822 and 143-146. It does not state that the common frame commutes with a pointwise gate or the identity D_out S D_in^{-1}, so nothing is derived.

S1.9 gives sum_e |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L (eq:rank-budget-labels). It leaves L undefined (L=Ich) and omits the nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3}, the fact that only the central 3->4 edges decrease (each by h), and the ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539.

No step states the projection matrices P_U, the negative source projection -P_{U_a}, the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, the shear H<-H+D, or s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. S1.13 only lists a page called circuit-to-address-permutation among its dependencies.

S1.10 says each edge change C_V C_U^{-1} is a product of one kernel per residual basis vector, and S1.16 gives C=aI+bX. Missing: the translation form aI+bX_v (or its inverse), the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and the telescoping to C^{tensor m} on every role after diagonal corrections.

S1.2 states s<Wm, so s/W<m, quoting the introduction. The reason (L<N/2, deficit N-2L>0), the relative deficits eta_b and eta_c, and the derivation of s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are all missing. S2.1.1 only lists tau as a fixed choice.

Digit moves, pointwise maps, row splits and controlled shifts are each stated as O(V). The conditions are dropped: S1.5 omits that W must divide R, and S1.6 omits that the target follows its controls and that the offset is prepared in b^{O(1)} time. Fixed rational scalings are not mentioned.

S1.11 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 correctly. S1.12 states exactly a interchanges plus O(V) but omits the hypotheses: fields over Z/q^b for a fixed odd prime q, and H before D. The elimination proof and the three-update realisation of each H_i<-H_i+D_j are not given.

S1.13 gives O(Ve^tau) for e=m^k, and S1.14 gives F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with F_k=O(e^tau) when s/W<m^tau. S1.13 drops the hypothesis that a preceding row field has length divisible by W^k. The construction (role split, edge shears by recursive interchanges, the shear H<-H+D, then D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D) and the fixed-tape schedule are not shown.
S1.15 states the O(Vu^tau) interchange of arbitrary-width chunks in agreement with Lemma lem:chunk-swap. The padding and row-field reduction are not described.

Only the ingredients appear: the kernel C and the per-edge product of kernels. Missing: the conjugation by P_M that moves the kernels to coordinate slots, the s_c child calls of C^{tensor f}, inverses via Z conjugation, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

S1.17 gives the functional effect: XOR selected bits and restore the scratch chunk. It omits the selected positions rho+iK, the eight cyclic shifts, the bad set delta_bad and its repair, and the cost O(V(L^tau+1)), which is the point of the lemma. Without the cost this counts only as a mention.
No step gives the row index from the first q_0 chunks, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), or the unrolling to d^{lambda'}.

S1.19 and S1.20 correctly state the O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, the error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, and the guard width p+ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) = O(p). Exact evaluation of the whole layer before one truncation is only implied, and the proof is absent.

The ring, omega_t, contraction, layout L, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, cost and retained order are stated correctly. The substeps of S1.24 restate the lemma's conclusions rather than derive them. Missing: F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the decimation and bit-reversed order, and the exact counterparts LBF_t^- and F_t^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.
Exact numerators, Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)) and error below sqrt2 2^{-p} match Lemma lem:signed-ring-product. The packing at B_0=2^{4p} with centered residues is not described.

S1.27 states M_r=(f*g)/(rM) via two forward transforms, a pointwise product and an opposite transform. The error bound sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, the cost, the exact scale by M and the reason P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) are missing.

Both identities and the approximation error and time are stated correctly. The hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4, the definitions of P_s and P_t, gamma=2d alpha^2, and the axis-exposure cost are missing.
Both identities, QF_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T and G(U.V_1)=(u*v)/S^2, are given correctly. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is not defined, and RF_s^+ by conjugation is not mentioned.

tau, sigma, beta, delta, b, p, d, K and T/2<S<T are stated correctly, and kappa appears in S0. Missing: lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, the T range and the t_i in {r/2,r}, the prime interval with eta=1/(4d), alpha, and alpha^4 theta_i>p. No existence argument for the primes is given.

The method names Phi: x->prod x_i^{mu_i} realised by controlled shifts, and S2.3.1 gives the isomorphism that preserves convolution (line 4220), which is the paper's route. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i is not defined, and the order-S argument, the triangular digit formula b_i and the cost are missing.

The steps follow the paper: (zeta y)^r=1 makes Theta well defined and diagonal, which gives the formula D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, plus approximate roots. Missing: the explicit statement that Theta is an isomorphism (or the wrap check), and the error analysis of the computed twisted convolution.

The chirp transform procedure and the source transform (A, chirp, B_0, scale 2^gamma, exact counterpart RF_s) follow the paper's route. Missing: the opposite procedure via conjugation, the digit scale 2^{-b-2}, and the six-step algorithm with its scales S and 2^{2b+4}S.

The route follows the paper: disk margins, cancellation to (u*v)/S^2, the final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, then carries with the right bounds and invariant. The error chain E_s=9*2^gamma TL and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, and the use of gamma<=b/4, are skipped, so the final bound appears without its derivation.

The route matches the paper: the seven dominant powers, min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, log factors at most p^kappa, then O(Tp p^{1-kappa}). The cost table and the margin formulas are not given, including g_2=epsilon c(1-tau), which ties the result to tau. The schoolbook cutoff is also missing.

S0.1 asserts that the bound disproves the conjecture but never says what an eventual lower bound means or that liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it. It is borderline between mentioned and stated; I chose the conservative verdict.

errors.says: Splitting whole rows cyclically into W role streams gives streams of equal shape and volume V/W.
errors.paper: Equal shape [P]x[R/W]x[B] and volume V/W hold when W divides R; the merge is also stated only in that case. Hence the padding of row counts to multiples of W (and W^k) elsewhere.

errors.says: A cyclic shift of a target field by an offset computed from its control fields costs O(V).
errors.paper: Linear cost requires the target field to follow its control fields and the offset to be preparable in b^{O(1)} time; the paper stresses that this order is preserved whenever the lemma is invoked.

errors.says: Two disjoint equal chunks of e=m^k digits are interchanged in O(Ve^tau) time for a fixed tau<1.
errors.paper: The proposition requires a row field preceding both chunks with length divisible by W^k, the contract eq:finite-shear-contract, and tau with s/W<m^tau. The general case needs Lemma lem:chunk-swap, which supplies rows from high digits.

chain: At the top level the tree follows the paper's route to the bound: fast tape tools (S1), then exactness of the transform pipeline (S2), then cost accounting (S3). S2 and S3 follow the paper's derivations in outline. S1, however, is a flat list of lemma statements taken from the paper. The network-to-recursion link is missing: the label budget is not turned into s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b through the rank-equals-dimension and source-exception argument, the endpoint identity giving the shear H<-H+D is absent, L<N/2 and the eta-based choice of tau are not shown, and the layer recurrence and phase-frame recursion for the numerical procedure are missing. The power saving behind the main bound is therefore asserted (s<Wm, F_k=O(e^tau)) rather than reconstructed.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored auxiliary wires is stated. h=100, the indexing by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are all absent, so the defining quantities of the network are missing.

S1.1 gives the consequence (intermediate frames cancel; the route applies D_sink D_source^{-1}). It omits the mechanism, that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that each edge then costs only a frame change. Conservative verdict.

Labels appear only through 'label dimension' in S1.9 and a page called subspace-labels. No step mentions nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3}, comparable labels on edges, or the central 3->4 edges each losing h.
No step says that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, or that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions.
S1.9 gives sum|Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L, but L=Ich is not defined and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is absent, so the budget never becomes the rank count.
S1.2 asserts s<Wm (quoting the introduction). It gives neither L/N=100/539 or 101/539, nor L<N/2, nor the deficit N-2L>0.
No step states M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m or that the bit network applies the shear H<-H+D on every role.

S1.11 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, S1.12 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and S1.2 calls s the number of smaller calls, which S1.13 then consumes. The q-adic hypothesis is omitted, but the mechanism and the count are present.

The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with V/W children (S1.5) and F_k=O(e^tau) is stated. tau=1-2^{-50} appears only as a fixed choice (S2.1.1), never derived from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so the exponent half of the step is missing. Conservative verdict.

central.summary: The plan names the ends of the central chain (the bank-exchange network, frames, s<Wm and the recurrence F_k=O(e^tau)) and reconstructs the edge-to-recursive-call step through the lower-triangular factorization. The middle of the chain is missing: rank equals dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear H<-H+D, and the eta-based derivation of tau=1-2^{-50}. The plan therefore does not show why s<Wm, only that it is used.
